messages:
maria: quick heads-up from staging: observed duplicate partial chunks when upstream early-closes and we fallback to resume. client gets repeated tokens and billing overlaps.
alex: can you post a tiny trace?
maria: repro: client->edge->upstream-A emits chunk then TCP close; edge forwards chunk and marks PREEMPTED; fallback to upstream-B replays from checkpoint and re-emits overlapping tokens => duplicates.
sam: sounds like two sources of truth (forwarded bytes + resumed tokens). we have FORWARDED_UNCOMMITTED flag but resume path ignores it.
jordan: options: 1) always prefer resume (drop forwarded bytes) 2) prefer forwarded for short gaps, resume for long gaps (tenant tunable) 3) negotiate trim with upstream via headers.
maria: proposal: add short-lived reservation id and headers `X-Edge-Reservation: <id>` + `X-Edge-Resume-Mode: bytes|tokens`. upstreams that support bytes can trim; others return 409 RESUME_MISMATCH.
alex: on 409, edge follows tenant policy: prefer-forwarded or prefer-resume. log a forensic event.
infra-bot: staging flag created: `edge.resume_reservation` default off. rollout group: canary-alpha.
sam: include metrics: duplicate_streams.rate, resume_mismatch.count, bytes_trimmed.total. alert if duplicates >0.1% streams.
jordan: security: reservation tokens TTL ~30s, base64 compact.
maria: i'll draft RFC and include compatibility plan, tests, and ops playbook. +1s?
alex: +1.
